## SocialDataX 微博 Weibo MCP

Search Weibo posts and users; read suggestions, trends, post details, comments, likes, reposts and video transcripts. This is a first-party SocialDataX integration to the SocialDataX hosted API; SocialDataX is independent of the social platforms whose data it provides. Use it to examine public content and compare the relevant posts, comments or profiles. Configure your own `SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY` as `Authorization: Bearer <SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY>`; [API Key and setup](https://socialdatax.com/ai?from=toolhive), with business calls billed in SocialDataX credits. Public connection materials are MIT; the hosted service implementation is proprietary.
